criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 25 June 2028 (18 months after the 25 December 2026 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 25 June 2028 (18 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 25 December 2029 (36 months after Closing).
Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($1,100,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.
Calculates the long-stop date as 17 January 2027 (90 days after signing on 19 October 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 31 January 2027 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (18 months) and as a date (25 June 2028), with days remaining from 17 November 2026 (586 days).
Notes that 25 June 2028 is a Sunday and that the release moves to the next Business Day, 26 June 2028.
Includes an 'Assumptions and open questions' section listing information that is missing or should be confirmed with the client.
